spec.problem: Admin Decks consumes fields absent from Go read responses and misreads cardCount as _count.cards.

acceptance.text: Admin decks route renders authenticated persisted deck data; filters, detail/audit, reason validation, export and authorized transitions behave against real API; anonymous and roleless access are secured; mobile controls remain reachable.
List/detail contracts expose card count, owner and descriptions consumed by the UI; authorized mutations persist audit records and unauthorized mutations fail at backend.

spec.expected_behavior: Read endpoints allow admin.content.read only; generate and transition require admin.content.write and CSRF, with no DB or audit side effects for a read-only actor.
spec.observed_behavior: A logged-in Admin with admin.content.read can GET deck data, but the Decks API routes are inside only AdminGuard and their write handlers have no RBAC/CSRF wrapper; UI write-button hiding cannot protect requests.
spec.rollback_plan: Revert frontend mapping and additive response fields.
